      AND (runs.available_at_ms IS NULL
        OR (typeof(runs.available_at_ms) = 'integer' AND runs.available_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000))
      AND (w.timeout_at_ms IS NULL
        OR (typeof(w.timeout_at_ms) = 'integer' AND w.timeout_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000))
                        AND w.step_name = runs.wake_step))
              OR (runs.wake_step IS NULL AND (SELECT MIN(w.step_name)
           FROM waits w
           WHERE w.run_id = runs.run_id
      AND w.queue = runs.queue
      AND w.task_id = runs.task_id
      AND w.event_name = runs.wake_event
      AND w.status = 'waiting'
      AND w.timeout_at_ms IS runs.available_at_ms
      AND (runs.available_at_ms IS NULL

            HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) IS NOT NULL)) and exists (select "f"."queue" from "events" as "f" where "f"."queue" = "runs"."queue" and "f"."event_name" = ? and "f"."fence_stamp" = ?) and (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks t

select "t"."task_id" as "task_id", (select "r"."run_id" from "runs" as "r" where (t.task_id = r.task_id AND t.queue = r.queue AND r.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')) order by "r"."attempt" desc limit 1) as "run_id" from "tasks" as "t" where (t.queue = ? AND ((typeof(t.cancel_at_ms) = 'integer' AND t.cancel_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)
    AND t.cancel_at_ms <= COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)
))
  AND t.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM runs ownership_run
    WHERE ownership_run.task_id = t.task_id
      AND ownership_run.queue <> t.queue
  )) order by "t"."cancel_at_ms", "t"."task_id" limit ?

select "r"."run_id", "r"."task_id", "r"."claim_gen", "r"."activated_gen", "r"."relaunch_count" from "runs" as "r" inner join "tasks" as "t" on (t.task_id = r.task_id AND t.queue = r.queue) where (r.queue = ? AND r.state = 'running'
  AND ((typeof(r.claim_expires_at_ms) = 'integer' AND r.claim_expires_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)
    AND r.claim_expires_at_ms <= COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)
))
  AND ((t.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping') AND (typeof(r.claim_gen) = 'integer' AND r.claim_gen BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
   AND (typeof(r.activated_gen) = 'integer' AND r.activated_gen BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
   AND (typeof(r.relaunch_count) = 'integer' AND r.relaunch_count BETWEEN 0 AND 5)
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs sibling
               WHERE sibling.task_id = r.task_id
                 AND sibling.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
                 AND sibling.run_id <> r.run_id)
   AND ((typeof(r.attempt) = 'integer' AND r.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
    AND (typeof(t.attempts) = 'integer' AND t.attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
    AND (typeof(t.max_attempts) = 'integer' AND t.max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
    AND (typeof(t.infra_retries) = 'integer' AND t.infra_retries BETWEEN 0 AND 20)
    AND t.attempts < t.max_attempts
    AND r.attempt = t.attempts + t.infra_retries + 1)
   AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM runs higher
    WHERE higher.task_id = r.task_id
      AND (NOT (typeof(higher.attempt) = 'integer' AND higher.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
        OR higher.attempt > r.attempt)
  )
   AND (r.activated_gen < r.claim_gen
     OR (r.activated_gen = r.claim_gen
       AND (t.infra_retries = 20
         OR ((typeof(r.attempt) = 'integer' AND r.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000019)
           AND r.attempt = t.attempts + t.infra_retries + 1)))))
    OR (t.state NOT IN ('pending','running','sleeping') AND (typeof(r.claim_gen) = 'integer' AND r.claim_gen BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
   AND (typeof(r.activated_gen) = 'integer' AND r.activated_gen BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
   AND (r.activated_gen = r.claim_gen
     OR (r.activated_gen < r.claim_gen
       AND (typeof(r.relaunch_count) = 'integer' AND r.relaunch_count BETWEEN 0 AND 5)
       AND r.relaunch_count = 5))))) order by "r"."claim_expires_at_ms", "r"."run_id" limit ?

select min("wakes"."v") as "wake_ms" from (select min("r"."available_at_ms") as "v" from "runs" as "r" where (r.queue = ? AND r.state = 'pending'
  AND (typeof(r.available_at_ms) = 'integer' AND r.available_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)) union all select min("r"."available_at_ms") as "v" from "runs" as "r" where (r.queue = ? AND r.state = 'sleeping'
  AND (typeof(r.available_at_ms) = 'integer' AND r.available_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)) union all select min("r"."claim_expires_at_ms") as "v" from "runs" as "r" where (r.queue = ? AND r.state = 'running'
  AND (typeof(r.claim_expires_at_ms) = 'integer' AND r.claim_expires_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)) union all select min("t"."cancel_at_ms") as "v" from "tasks" as "t" where (t.queue = ? AND t.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
  AND (typeof(t.cancel_at_ms) = 'integer' AND t.cancel_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000))) as "wakes"

select "t"."task_name" from "runs" as "r" inner join "tasks" as "t" on (t.task_id = r.task_id AND t.queue = r.queue) where "r"."run_id" = ? and "r"."queue" = ? and "r"."claimed_by" = ? and "r"."state" = 'running' and "r"."claim_gen" = ? and "r"."activated_gen" < ?

select "c"."checkpoint_name", "c"."state", "c"."owner_run_id", "c"."owner_attempt" from "checkpoints" as "c" inner join "runs" as "owner" on ((typeof(c.owner_attempt) = 'integer' AND c.owner_attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
   AND owner.run_id = c.owner_run_id
   AND owner.task_id = c.task_id
   AND owner.queue = c.queue
   AND owner.attempt = c.owner_attempt) where "c"."task_id" = ? and "c"."queue" = ? and "c"."status" = 'committed' and "c"."owner_attempt" <= ? order by "c"."checkpoint_name"

select "state", "completed_payload", "failure_reason", (CASE WHEN tasks.state NOT IN ('pending','running','sleeping') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkpoints sp
           WHERE sp.task_id = tasks.task_id
             AND sp.checkpoint_name = '$rolling-back')
        THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkpoints ss
           WHERE ss.task_id = tasks.task_id
             AND ss.checkpoint_name >= '$started:'
   AND ss.checkpoint_name < '$started;'
             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkpoints sr
           WHERE sr.task_id = ss.task_id
             AND sr.checkpoint_name = '$rollback:'
               || substr(ss.checkpoint_name, 10))) THEN 'failed' ELSE 'complete' END
   END) as "rollback_outcome", (SELECT st.state FROM checkpoints st
     WHERE st.task_id = tasks.task_id
       AND st.checkpoint_name >= '$rollback-tries:'
   AND st.checkpoint_name < '$rollback-tries;'
       AND st.owner_run_id = tasks.last_attempt_run
     LIMIT 1) as "rollback_error" from "tasks" where "task_id" = ? and "queue" = ?
